name: Inspect files before opening a document

elements.name: Reset drawing options when switching selected files

steps.name: writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder
the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings
the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
two saved drawings are visible in the same folder
the first drawing is selected in the Options pane
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked for the first drawing
`OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` are visible in the same folder
the user selects Load in Defer Mode
the user selects the second drawing
the second drawing is selected and its file name is displayed
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked for the second drawing
the user selects the first drawing again
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked
the drawing remains selected without being opened
